title: enform flow definition
description: One flow definition document, version 2 (MVP.md DF-1, DF-4, I9). A flow is one JSON document with an integer schemaVersion. The optional anonymous setting is ID-3; a step shows either flat fields or sections (FM-1) and sets which fields are visible and editable (FM-3); each rule uses one JSON Logic condition and one of six effects (FM-2, FM-5); and connector read operations supply option lists and default values (FM-6).

fields.description: The form fields that the step shows (FM-1).

sections.description: The named groups of fields that the step shows (FM-1).

visible.description: The field keys the step shows; absent means every field (FM-3).

editable.description: The field keys the actor may edit; absent means none (FM-3).

rules.description: The conditions on data, step and user that show, hide, collapse, require, lock or skip fields and sections (FM-2, FM-5).

section.description: One named group of fields (FM-1). `collapsed` is an optional presentation default.

field.description: One form field: a key, one of the sixteen controls (FM-1), the option list of a choice control, and the optional required, default and connector-supplied values (FM-6).

optionsFrom.description: The connector read operation that supplies the option list (FM-6).

valueFrom.description: The connector read operation that supplies the default value (FM-6).

control.description: The sixteen form controls of FM-1.

target.description: A task recipient: exactly one kind, per AS-1. Dynamic targets are starter, field and manager-of.

jsonLogic.description: A JSON Logic expression tree (FM-5, ADR 0008), also the shape of any field default (FM-6).

rule.description: One condition with one effect on the fields and sections it targets (FM-2, FM-5).
